scientific_integrity: Theorem proved combinatorially; reproducibility program separately checks bounded instances; no human or independent audit asserted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform iid host words; not fixed-composition, biased or dependent sources; no variance or concentration assertion. Possible equivalent formula in unindexed literature. Finite checks do not replace proof.
scientific_scope: Exact first moment for all word lengths over each fixed labeled alphabet of size \(q\ge3\); includes ternary rational function and exponential asymptotic. Binary case is not claimed as new.
title: Universal alphabet-size law for the mean number of shortest absent subsequences
